sourceOccurrences.label: Lattice geometry in every nonnegative dimension
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Grouped exposition of all twenty named theorem contracts
sourceOccurrences.note: 6RWC fixes the nearest-neighbour convention. 8QCR covers degree, distance, finite balls and symmetries, including the single vertex in dimension zero. The distinct step vectors supply neighbour injectivity; the coordinatewise construction and walk-length lower bound supply the graph metric. Helpers are grouped into those arguments. No theorem in this module assumes a percolation law.

sourceOccurrences.label: Lattice path counts and their growth rate
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Grouped exposition with a separate bond consequence
sourceOccurrences.note: RSRP and 7DGG cover finiteness, automorphism transport, root independence, splitting and submultiplicativity. Positive-dimensional straight paths and the degree estimate give the hypotheses and bounds for F3YB. The infimum characterization follows from the source limit and pointwise lower bound; the article also gives the logarithmic proof. The dimension-one witness is included. H35T is additional bond-percolation exposition, not an export of this module. Source literature locators are unchecked.

proofUses.reason: The signed coordinate steps determine degree, graph distance and the lattice symmetries.
Translation identifies root counts, and cutting and translating a path gives the submultiplicative injection.
The logarithms of the positive path counts are subadditive; quotient and remainder give the growth rate.
The simple-path union bound and nonnegative endpoint sum are the bounded-degree argument with the actual lattice path counts; growth below the reciprocal parameter makes the series finite.
A definition; it invokes no other wiki assertion.
